_comment: Standardized definition of each Performance Summary / Experience Metrics row. Edit thresholds here instead of in create_html_reports.py. 'higher_is_better' controls which end of 'assessment_thresholds' is 'good'. Each threshold tier carries its own 'class' (good/moderate/poor) for the status pill color - assessment is judged against a fixed quality bar for the metric itself, NOT against other venues (there is deliberately no network benchmark here - see below).
_no_benchmark_comment: An earlier version of this file had a 'benchmark' (network average) per metric, used to show 'Above/On par/Below average' vs. other venues. That was removed: individual venue reports are usually generated from a single venue's data, so a hardcoded 'network average' constant was often stale or simply fictional for whatever CSV was actually being processed. Cross-venue comparison belongs in the separate Venue Rankings Weekly report (see templates/REPORT_TEMPLATES_VENUE_RANKINGS.md), which computes real averages/ranks from all venues present in that run's data. If a per-venue report ever needs a benchmark again, compute it live from the venues actually loaded in that run rather than reintroducing a static constant.
